## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes. Also include relevant motivation and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

Please mark the options that are relevant:

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🧹 Code refactor / Chore (no functional changes)

## How Has This Been Tested?

Please describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes:

- [ ] Tested locally with Python `3.x`
- [ ] Verified commands execute properly in a test Discord voice & text channel
- [ ] Verified persistent single session message updates without creating duplicate messages
- [ ] Verified code compilation (`python -m py_compile ...`)
